assign.title: Chat v3: hide a chit-chat prompt's title when it just repeats its own body
assign.outcome:
Fixed: a Chat v3 Prompt with no AI title and no refined text (e.g. "Hello") showed its own words twice — a muted first-words title, then the identical one-line body under it. ChatV3.prompt() now hides that title when it is a duplicate, or the Prompt is a sentence or two with no refined version; a real topic card (an AI title, or refined text) always keeps its title. Replies still nest on the card either way. Landed on michael/dev, pushed.
